description: GET /v1/builds/{id}/events (streamBuildEvents) answers only `text/event-stream` (Server-Sent Events: `state`, `log` and `done` frames, open for up to 20 minutes). The converter reads JSON bodies only, so it generated with an empty output: a call would wait until the build ends and then return nothing. The shared REST protocol has no Server-Sent Events framing (core has NDJSON only). Remove the operation; poll getBuild until `state` is `ready`, `failed` or `canceled`, which the spec names as the alternative ("or poll `GET /v1/builds/{id}`").
